title: Casting Renderer Runtime
problem: Nako should support casting, but it needs Renderer Sessions, renderer-control commands, adapter boundaries, and cast-safe transport instead of stretching browser tickets or Transcode Session IDs into protocol-specific playback control.

evidence.summary: Opened the casting renderer runtime lane and ADR 0040, choosing Renderer Sessions plus protocol adapters with Nako-to-Nako cast before Chromecast, DLNA, or AirPlay.

Added characterization tests proving Public Client has Playback Session routes and heartbeat, but no renderer/cast route surface, renderer session identity, target handoff, or command capability fields yet.

continue_policy.notes: CAST-020 characterized the current gap. Continue with CAST-030 Renderer Session and Renderer Command domain records before adding Nako-to-Nako registration.
